test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

A storm in a tea cup

options.text: Great outrage or excitement about a trivial matter
Constant source of annoyance to someone
To deal with a person who is more than one's match

solution:
The correct answer is "**Great outrage or excitement about a trivial matter**."
